result.summary: Activity from IP 203.0.138.88 is consistent with an attempt to execute a SQL query on web-app-02, which was blocked by the WAF. The API gateway forwarded the query to db-prod-02, but the database audit logs indicate permission denial. The application service log on api-service-02 reports a successful query execution from the same IP, which is cached and returned with HTTP 200 status. The session sess-web-5501 was terminated normally on web-app-02.

confidence.rationale: The WAF detection event (EV-DET-02) has a confidence score of 0.7, which is considered moderate.
limitations: No direct evidence of successful unauthorized access to the database cluster, only permission denial logs.

observedFacts.statement: Inbound HTTP POST request on /api/v2/query from IP 203.0.113.88 on web-app-02 (session sess-web-5501) was detected by the WAF (EV-DET-02).
The API gateway forwarded the query to db-prod-02 on behalf of session sess-web-5501 (EV-FWD-03).
The database audit logs on db-prod-02 indicate permission denial for the query (EV-DB-AUDIT-04).
The application service log on api-service-02 reports a successful query execution (EV-APP-LOG-05).
The session sess-web-5501 was terminated normally on web-app-02 (EV-SESS-06).

inferences.statement: The API gateway forwarded the query to db-prod-02, but the database audit logs indicate permission denial, suggesting the query was blocked by the database.
inferences.rationale: The API gateway event (EV-FWD-03) indicates the query was forwarded to db-prod-02, and the database audit logs (EV-DB-AUDIT-04) show permission denial, implying the query was not executed successfully.

unknowns.statement: No evidence of successful unauthorized access to the database cluster was found.
unknowns.significance: It is unclear if the query was executed successfully or if it was blocked by the database.
unknowns.recommendedTelemetry: Monitor the database audit logs for further activity.

attackProgression.description: The attacker initiated a query on the web application.
The API gateway forwarded the query to the database, which denied the permission.
The application service log on the backend API service reported a successful query execution.

recommendedActions.rationale: The WAF detected and blocked the malicious IP address (203.0.113.88) that initiated the attack.
recommendedActions.expectedImpact: Containment of the attack by blocking the malicious IP address.
